title: User profile editing (display name) for signed-in users

requirements.summary: Provide an authenticated-user "Edit Profile" entry point and dialog to update display name after onboarding.
acceptanceCriteria: When a user is signed in, there is a visible entry point labeled "Edit Profile" available from the main UI (e.g., header or account area).
Selecting "Edit Profile" opens a dialog or page that pre-fills the current saved name (if any) and allows changing it.
Submitting the form saves the updated name via the existing profile save flow and shows a success message.
After saving, any UI that depends on the caller profile reflects the updated name without requiring a full page reload.
If the user is not authenticated, the edit profile entry point is not shown (or is disabled with a clear sign-in requirement).

file_operations.description: Create an EditProfileDialog composed from existing shadcn/ui primitives (do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui). Use the authorization component’s frontend guidance by relying on existing authentication state (useInternetIdentity) and caller profile hooks (useGetCallerUserProfile, useSaveCallerUserProfile) to (1) prefill the current name, (2) allow editing, (3) save, and (4) show a success toast/message; invalidate/refetch should ensure the updated name is reflected without a full reload. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a signed-in-only, clearly labeled "Edit Profile" entry point in the header main UI that opens EditProfileDialog; hide (or disable with a clear sign-in requirement) when unauthenticated. Also fetch and display the current profile name in the header (e.g., next to account actions) so the name visibly updates after save via React Query cache invalidation. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Wire profile editing to the existing caller profile save flow and avoid introducing any new backend APIs or schema changes.
acceptanceCriteria: The profile edit flow calls the existing backend method for saving the caller profile (no duplicate APIs).
No backend state schema changes are required for this feature.

file_operations.description: Ensure the save action uses the existing profile save flow by calling the existing React Query mutation hook (useSaveCallerUserProfile) which invokes the backend saveCallerUserProfile method; do not add any new backend calls. Handle authorization failures gracefully (e.g., show an error toast if the backend rejects unauthenticated callers), per the authorization component guidance. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Confirm the existing caller profile query key and invalidation behavior support immediate UI refresh after a successful save (e.g., currentUserProfile invalidation is sufficient). If needed, extend the hook ergonomics (without changing backend calls) to support the edit dialog’s success/error handling while continuing to call the same existing backend method. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
